result:
I added `apps/react-vite/e2e/tests/discussion-comments.spec.ts`. Per your instructions I did not run any tests, lint or the app, so it is untested.

It follows the smoke test's flow and selectors. The steps are:
- Create a discussion and open its page.
- Add two comments with distinct bodies (the generated body plus a "- first" or "- second" suffix).
- Delete the first comment, which leaves exactly one list item and the second comment visible.
- Delete the discussion at the end so the test leaves no data behind, as the smoke test does.

Two things differ from the smoke test because there are now two comments on the page:
- **Delete button:** the "Delete Comment" button is scoped to the first comment's list item.
- **Confirm button:** the confirm click is scoped to the dialog. A plain role lookup would match several "Delete Comment" buttons.

I based the `comments` list label and per-comment list items on `comments-list.tsx`. I did not check the rendered dialog markup, so the `dialog` role is an assumption.
